title: Huaca Prieta Twined and Woven Artifacts, Part 1: Textiles
version: Where the Land Meets the Sea, chapter 12, DOI 10.7560/311493-015. Full chapter text rendered by ResearchGate with some font-encoding losses.
lineage: Primary structural examination of excavated textiles and loose yarns. The principal analyst and excavation collection overlap with the 2016 indigo analysis, but Table 12.5 examines a broader set of textile and yarn specimens and records their structure rather than dye chemistry.

passages.note: Analysis of loose yarns and yarns in fabrics identifies multiple structures, including two-ply yarn used in weft twining. The author interprets differences in yarn diameters and twist as suited to the intended fabric.

passages.locator: Fig. 12.1d and Color, Pigment, and Dye
passages.note: Illustrates the early blue textile 2009.052.01.B, tested for indigo in the 2016 study. The chapter and article differ on the phase number. The stratum and sample ID match.
